digest.component_or_area: instance role IAM policy for Bedrock access
propositions: review-bot container requires Bedrock credentials scoped by instance role, with bedrock:InvokeModel and bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream actions on Claude foundation models and inference profiles

bedrock:Converse API authorizes against bedrock:InvokeModel (not bedrock:Converse action), proven only by runtime call from instance role; policy simulator alone cannot distinguish which action a service checks
IMDSv2 reachability from containers on the host selects between IAM-only implementation and conditional hop-limit increase; default assumption is IMDS reachable, confirmed before any other change
scope binding requires region wildcards on both foundation-model and inference-profile ARNs because cross-region profiles invoke models in their member regions, not only us-east-1
no static AWS credential env vars present in review-bot container; all authentication flows through instance role metadata service
